reviews.review_description: What makes wingshift so cool is the fact that it hasn't been done before in VR. It's almost an exercise game disguised as a first person on-rails flyer/shooter. The main mechanic is both original and physically engaging, and I got a decent little shoulder workout (with a few squats to boot) after playing for a few minutes.There's a lot of potential here! Is there a discord? I have some ideas for how to improve it.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the kind words! I really appreciate you taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review.

I'd love to hear your ideas and feedback. I just launched a Discord server, so feel free to join and share them here:

https://discord.gg/5MgbwzJJ96

Thanks again for playing and for taking the time to leave such a thoughtful review!

reviews.review_description: Its an interesting and a little difficult experience, but it was for sure well executed. I may not know the most about what makes a good vr game, just know that i think this one is amazing, and deserves a try from anyone who sees it.

developer_response.body: Thanks so much! Really glad you enjoyed it, and I really appreciate the review 😄
